info.title: OpenArtifact API
info.description: Enterprise-grade artifact repository manager with support for multiple package formats

gpg_key_id.description: Fingerprint of the key that signed the manifest; null when unsigned.

gpg_signature.description: Armored detached signature of the manifest; null when unsigned.

repo_id.description: UUID of the repository the stage must promote into; empty for any.

instance_id.description: Operator-configured instance name; omitted when OPENARTIFACT_INSTANCE_ID is empty

projects.description: The caller's project roles; global admins are implicit owners everywhere and are listed only for roles they hold.

max_stale_seconds.description: Seconds past a cached file's expiry during which it may still be served, with a Warning: 110 header, when the upstream is unreachable, times out or answers 5xx. 0 disables serve-stale; default 604800 (7 days); max 31536000.

project.description: Name of the project that owns the repository (the built-in 'system' project unless set at creation or moved). Members of any other project get access to the repository according to their role; see docs/security/rbac.md.

permissions.description: The caller's effective repository-scoped permissions. Only present in the single-repository GET (`/api/v1/repository/{name}`); global administrators have every flag set.

delete.description: Allows the repository's trash tab (list and restore).

admin.description: Allows configuring and deleting the repository and managing its cleanup policies and quota: global administrators and maintainers or owners of the repository's project.

presign_downloads.description: Per-repository override of storage.presignDownloads: true always redirects eligible blob downloads to a presigned object-store URL, false always streams, null inherits the global setting. Metadata and manifests are never redirected.

trash_retention_days.description: Days a deleted item (or the repository itself) stays restorable in the trash before the retention purge removes it. null = the server default (TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS); 0 = no trash, deletes are immediate and permanent.

immutable_releases.description: When true, deleting or overwriting a released version is refused with 409 (SNAPSHOT/pre-release versions stay mutable). An admin can override with ?force=true.

merge_proxy_versions.description: Group repositories only. false (default): for a package name held by a readable hosted member, proxy members' versions of that name are hidden (hosted members win, dependency-confusion protection). true: merge proxy versions with the hosted ones. Only administrators can set it.

sign_packages.description: Hosted rpm repositories only (400 otherwise when true). When true, uploaded RPMs are signed with the active GPG key; existing packages are not re-signed.

priority.description: Resolution order within the group (lowest first)

repo_id.description: Empty for a project default policy.

project_id.description: Set for a project default policy.

payload_format.description: Delivery body format. openartifact is the native JSON; cloudevents is CloudEvents 1.0 structured mode (application/cloudevents+json); slack, teams and discord are the services' incoming-webhook shapes.

has_secret.description: Secret is write-only and never returned

token.description: The raw token value (only returned on creation)

created_by.description: Username that minted a project token

total.description: Number of matching packages (repositories are not counted); with group=package, the number of distinct packages

packages.description: Matching packages/artifacts, best match first (exact name, prefix, other substring), then newest first. With group=package, one entry per package: its latest version

repositories.description: Repositories whose own name matches the query, ordered by name

primary.description: True for the tier backed by the server's configured storage.

backend.description: Name of the storage backend the tier maps to; null for the primary tier.

available.description: False when this server could not open the tier's backend.

position.description: Evaluation order, lowest first. New policies default to after the last one.

target_tier.description: Name of the tier matching blobs belong on.

from_tier.description: Only blobs currently on this tier.

repo_glob.description: Repository name glob: * matches within a segment, ** across '/', ? one character.

path_glob.description: Package path glob (same syntax as repo_glob).

truncated.description: True when the scan stopped at its row cap; totals are then a lower bound.

GPGKey.description: A signing key. Private key material is never part of the API.

id.description: UUID, or `config` for the read-only key configured through gpg.keyPath

key_id.description: Long key id (last 16 hex digits of the fingerprint)

active_global.description: Signs every deb/rpm repository that has no key of its own

repositories.description: Repositories this key is assigned to

end_session_url.description: IdP RP-initiated logout URL (id_token_hint, client_id, post_logout_redirect_uri).

OIDCConfig.description: OIDC/OAuth 2.0 provider settings. client_secret is write-only: responses carry has_secret instead.

type.description: Empty: standards-compliant OIDC (issuer discovery). github: GitHub / GitHub Enterprise Server (OAuth 2.0). oauth2: generic OAuth 2.0 with a userinfo endpoint.

issuer.description: Issuer URL (required for type ""). https://accounts.google.com enforces email_verified; https://login.microsoftonline.com/{common|organizations|consumers}/v2.0 is a multi-tenant Entra authority and requires allowed_tenants.

scopes.description: Default: openid email profile (github: read:user user:email read:org). Request groups explicitly if the IdP needs it.

allowed_tenants.description: Entra tenant IDs (GUIDs) allowed to sign in. Required for multi-tenant authorities.

hosted_domain.description: Google Workspace domain: sent as the hd authorization parameter and required in the hd claim.

require_email_verified.description: Deny logins whose email is not verified by the IdP (always on for Google).

graph_groups.description: Resolve Entra groups overage through Microsoft Graph (needs a delegated User.Read access token; group_mapping keys are group object IDs).

userinfo_url.description: type oauth2: userinfo endpoint (subject is sub, else id).

auth_base_url.description: type github: base URL of GitHub Enterprise Server (default https://github.com).

api_base_url.description: type github: API base URL (default https://api.github.com).

allowed_orgs.description: type github: organizations whose members may sign in (required). Groups are "org" and "org/team-slug", lower-case.

saml_config.description: SAML settings (kind=saml). At least one IdP metadata source is required on create; the URL wins when both are set.

idp_metadata_url.description: HTTPS URL of the IdP metadata. Refreshed in the background, so IdP certificate rollover is picked up without editing the provider.

idp_metadata_xml.description: Static IdP metadata document. Never refreshed; its validUntil is ignored.

idp_metadata_refresh_seconds.description: How long fetched IdP metadata is reused before it is re-read from idp_metadata_url. 0 or unset means 3600; otherwise 60 to 86400. A shorter cacheDuration or validUntil in the metadata itself wins (floor 60s).

username_attribute.description: Assertion attribute Name for the username (default uid).

email_attribute.description: Assertion attribute Name for the email (default mail).

name_attribute.description: Assertion attribute Name for the display name (default displayName).

groups_attribute.description: Assertion attribute Name carrying group values. When set and present in the assertion (even with no values) the user's SSO group memberships are synced to that set; when absent from the assertion existing memberships are kept.

allow_idp_initiated.description: Accept IdP-initiated (unsolicited) responses, e.g. from an IdP app tile. Off by default: such responses are not bound to a login request this server started, so login CSRF is possible. Signature, audience, recipient and replay checks still apply.

slug.description: URL-safe unique identifier derived from the name: lowercased, runs of characters outside a-z0-9 collapsed to '-', at most 64 characters. A name or slug collision on create returns 409.

allowed_formats.description: Package formats repositories of this project may use. null allows every format.

allowed_repo_types.description: Repository types allowed in this project.

repo_name_prefix.description: Prefix every repository name in this project must start with. Empty means no prefix is required.

allow_public_repos.description: Whether repositories of this project may be public.

max_repositories.description: Maximum number of repositories the project may own. 0 means unlimited.

token_max_ttl_days.description: Maximum lifetime in days of tokens scoped to this project. 0 means no cap.

my_role.description: The caller's effective role in the project; a global admin without a role is an implicit owner.

is_system.description: The built-in system project: it grants nothing and cannot be deleted.

ProjectRole.description: One project role of the caller.

self_create.description: Whether any human user may create a project (and become its owner).

allowed_formats.description: Package formats repositories of this project may use. null allows every format.

allowed_repo_types.description: Repository types allowed in this project.

repo_name_prefix.description: Prefix every repository name in this project must start with. Empty means no prefix is required.

allow_public_repos.description: Whether repositories of this project may be public.

max_repositories.description: Maximum number of repositories the project may own. 0 means unlimited.

token_max_ttl_days.description: Maximum lifetime in days of tokens scoped to this project. 0 means no cap.

owner.description: Username of the owner. Global admins only; defaults to the caller.

ProjectUpdateRequest.description: Partial update: omitted fields stay unchanged.

allowed_formats.description: Package formats repositories of this project may use. null allows every format.

allowed_repo_types.description: Repository types allowed in this project.

repo_name_prefix.description: Prefix every repository name in this project must start with. Empty means no prefix is required.

allow_public_repos.description: Whether repositories of this project may be public.

max_repositories.description: Maximum number of repositories the project may own. 0 means unlimited.

token_max_ttl_days.description: Maximum lifetime in days of tokens scoped to this project. 0 means no cap.

username.description: Alternative to user_id; exactly one of the two is required.

ProjectMemberCreateRequest.description: Exactly one of user_id and username.

sbom_data.description: The SBOM document (only on the detail endpoint)

enforced.description: True when a limit is set.

ProjectActivityEntry.description: One audit event of a project or of a repository it owns. Carries no client address.

actor.description: Username or token name of the actor; empty when unknown.

has_more.description: True when entries follow this page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Absent when `has_more` is false.

status.description: Scan status. Vulnerability scans use pending|scanning|completed|partial|failed (see VulnScanResult.scan_status).

VulnScanOverviewRow.description: A vulnerability scan without its findings (`vulnerabilities`), with the name and format of its repository. Fetch the findings with GET /api/v1/repositories/{name}/vuln/scans/{id}.

repository_format.description: Format of the repository (npm, pypi, maven, ...).

scanner.description: One scanner name (osv, trivy or grype) or a sorted comma-joined list such as `osv,trivy`.

scan_error.description: Sanitized summary of the failing scanners.

VulnScanSummary.description: Counts of the scans in the overview.

severity_at_least.description: Scans with at least one finding of that severity or worse: `high` counts the scans with a critical or a high finding, and so on. Matches the `severity` filter of the list.

VulnScanResult.description: Result of one vulnerability scan of an artifact.

scanner.description: One scanner name (osv, trivy or grype) or a sorted comma-joined list such as `osv,trivy` when several scanners were requested.

scan_status.description: `completed`: every requested scanner ran. `partial`: several scanners were requested and some failed (findings of the others are kept; see `failed_scanners`). `failed`: every scanner failed - the zero counts then mean `not scanned`, not `no vulnerabilities`.

scan_error.description: Sanitized summary of the failing scanners, for example `trivy: scanner is not available on the server (scanner_unavailable), setup guide: <url>; osv: scan timed out`. A scanner that is not installed or has no vulnerability database names its code (`scanner_unavailable`, `scanner_db_unavailable`) and the setup guide. It never contains raw scanner output or upstream error text. Null unless `scan_status` is `partial` or `failed`.

failed_scanners.description: Scanners that produced no result. Empty unless `scan_status` is `partial` or `failed`.

VulnScanner.description: Whether one vulnerability scanner can run on the server. Fixed, client-safe text only.

available.description: False when the `trivy` / `grype` binary is not installed or not executable.

ready.description: True when a scan can run now: `osv` always; `trivy` and `grype` when the binary is available and its vulnerability database is present.

db_state.description: State of the vulnerability database of an available `trivy` / `grype`; null otherwise.

db_updated_at.description: When the vulnerability database was last refreshed; null when there is none or the time is unknown.

install_state.description: State of the automatic installer (`scanners.<name>.install: auto`) for a `trivy` / `grype` binary that is being or was downloaded by the server; null when the binary is not managed by the installer.

code.description: Why the scanner is not ready; null when it is.

message.description: What the operator must do when the scanner is not ready.

docs_url.description: Link to the scanner installation guide when the scanner is not ready.

scanner.description: Single scanner. Still accepted; merged with `scanners`.

scanners.description: Scanners to run. Merged with `scanner`; de-duplicated and sorted. Defaults to `osv` when neither is given.

violation.description: The violated rule, naming the offending license.

LicenseScanResult.description: Result of one license scan of an artifact.

unresolved_licenses.description: Entries of licenses that are not SPDX expressions: raw text read from the artifact ("BSD", "BSD License"), kept as written and flagged for review.

license_source.description: `artifact`: the licenses include ones read from the stored package file. `client_declared`: they only come from what a client declared (license properties) because the file declares no license, or cannot be read and no blocking policy applies.

quarantined.description: Downloads of the artifact answer 403 ARTIFACT_QUARANTINED until an admin approves it.

quarantine_approved.description: An admin approved the artifact for its current licenses; cleared when a re-scan finds different licenses.

LicenseBlockedError.description: Upload rejected by a license policy with action `block`.

LicensePolicyUnavailableError.description: The license policies could not be read; the upload failed closed.

LicenseMetadataUnsafeError.description: Upload rejected (422): the package file's own metadata is oversized or ambiguous (a decompression bomb, or two candidate metadata files), so its licenses cannot be checked.

LicenseMetadataUnreadableError.description: Upload rejected (422): the repository has an enabled license policy with action `block` and the package's license cannot be derived from the package file (a file type without readable metadata, a damaged archive), so only the client's own claims would decide the policy.

LicenseScanRunResult.description: Result of POST .../license/scan: the recorded license scan plus the policy violations it triggered.

unresolved_licenses.description: Entries of licenses that are not SPDX expressions: raw text read from the artifact ("BSD", "BSD License"), kept as written and flagged for review.

license_source.description: `artifact`: the licenses include ones read from the stored package file. `client_declared`: they only come from what a client declared (license properties) because the file declares no license, or cannot be read and no blocking policy applies.

quarantined.description: Downloads of the artifact answer 403 ARTIFACT_QUARANTINED until an admin approves it.

quarantine_approved.description: An admin approved the artifact for its current licenses; cleared when a re-scan finds different licenses.

policy_violations.description: Always an array (empty when no policy is violated).

dry_run.description: Report what would be deleted without deleting anything

grace_period_seconds.description: Minimum age of what may be deleted; 0 disables the grace period. Omitted: the configured workers.dockerGcGracePeriod

manifests_deleted.description: Untagged manifests deleted (would be, in a dry run)

blob_refs_deleted.description: Blob records of the repository no manifest references any more

blobs_freed.description: Storage objects removed; in a dry run an upper bound that ignores sharing with other repositories

failures.description: Storage deletions that failed (logged server-side; the orphan collector retries them)

truncated.description: manifests/blobs are capped at 1000 entries each

rows.description: Package rows a run would remove (one per file for formats that store files separately)

path.description: Artifact path inside the repository (no empty, '.' or '..' segments)

size.description: Exact size in bytes; signed into the upload URL. Above 5 GiB (5368709120) `multipart` must be true; the limit is 5 TiB.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the content; verified at completion

content_type.description: Content type to record; detected from the content when omitted

multipart.description: Upload the object in parts: PUT each part to a URL from the parts endpoint, then call complete. Required above 5 GiB; not allowed for an empty file.

part_size.description: Part size in bytes of a multipart upload (5 MiB to 4000 MiB, at most 10000 parts); the server picks one (64 MiB or more) when omitted

multipart.description: True for a multipart upload: no upload_url is returned, fetch part URLs from the parts endpoint

part_size.description: Multipart only: size of every part but the last

part_count.description: Multipart only: number of parts, numbered from 1

upload_url.description: Single upload only: presigned URL accepting one PUT of exactly `size` bytes. The query string is a credential: do not log it.

headers.description: Headers that must be sent with the PUT

part_numbers.description: 1-based numbers of the parts to sign, at most the upload's part_count

upload_url.description: Presigned URL accepting one PUT of exactly `size` bytes. The query string is a credential: do not log it.

headers.description: Headers that must be sent with the PUT

size.description: Exact size of the part in bytes

expires_at.description: When the part URLs stop working

TrashItem.description: A soft-deleted package row or repository. It is hidden everywhere else until restored; the retention purge removes it at purge_at.

id.description: Primary key of the trashed row (the repository id for kind repository). Together with kind it addresses the item.

repository.description: Name of the owning repository (the trashed repository itself for kind repository).

name.description: Package name, file path, image:tag or (kind repository) the repository name.

version.description: Omitted when the kind has no version.

purge_at.description: deleted_at plus the repository's effective retention.

remaining.description: Trashed items left (a request purges at most 1000).

data.description: Format-specific metadata of the stored package (name, version, arch, sha256, ...)

trashed.description: The package went to the trash and can be restored (absent for deb and rpm)

key_id.description: Hex sha256 of the DER public key.

api_key_set.description: The API key is write-only; this tells whether one is stored.

auto_push.description: Push the BOM on upload and after each scan.

push_vex.description: After Dependency-Track's analysis, push the VEX decisions.

ready.description: Enabled with a URL and an API key.

subject.description: Digest of the image manifest the attestation is attached to

created.description: False when an identical attestation was already attached

replaced.description: Digest of the earlier attestation this one replaced

vex_statements.description: VEX statements sent (decisions matching a vulnerability Dependency-Track reports).

vex_applied.description: Findings carrying an analysis in Dependency-Track after the import.

post.description: Create a new repository (admin only)

repo_type.description: hosted (default), proxy or group. Proxy repositories are supported for maven, deb, rpm, docker, go, npm, nuget, pypi, cargo, helm and raw; group repositories for maven, deb, rpm, docker, go, npm, nuget, pypi, cargo, helm and raw (deb and rpm groups serve generated Release/Packages or repodata merged across their members). Docker proxies and groups are served under /v2/ only. Other combinations are rejected with 400 validation_failed. Proxy and group repositories are read-only.

upstream_url.description: Required for proxy repos, except docker (defaults to https://registry-1.docker.io), nuget (defaults to the service index https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json), pypi (defaults to https://pypi.org/simple) cargo (defaults to https://index.crates.io) and go (defaults to https://proxy.golang.org). Plain http(s) base URL without credentials, query or fragment; validated against the outbound (SSRF) policy.

max_stale_seconds.description: Seconds past a cached file's expiry during which it may still be served, with a Warning: 110 header, when the upstream is unreachable, times out or answers 5xx. 0 disables serve-stale; default 604800 (7 days); max 31536000.

member_repos.description: For group repos: ordered member repository names (first hit wins). Members must be hosted or proxy repositories of the group's format; groups cannot be nested.

project.description: Name of the owning project. Defaults to the built-in system project, whose membership grants nothing. Unknown project: 404.

presign_downloads.description: Per-repository override of storage.presignDownloads: true always redirects eligible blob downloads to a presigned object-store URL, false always streams, null inherits the global setting. Metadata and manifests are never redirected.

trash_retention_days.description: Days a deleted item (or the repository itself) stays restorable in the trash before the retention purge removes it. null/absent = the server default (TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS); 0 = no trash, deletes are immediate and permanent.

immutable_releases.description: When true, deleting or overwriting a released version is refused with 409 (SNAPSHOT/pre-release versions stay mutable). An admin can override with ?force=true.

merge_proxy_versions.description: Group repositories only, administrators only (403 otherwise). Default false: hosted members win a package name and proxy versions of the same name are hidden. true merges proxy versions into the group.

sign_packages.description: Hosted rpm repositories only (400 otherwise when true). When true, uploaded RPMs are signed with the active GPG key; existing packages are not re-signed.

409.description: A repository with this name already exists, or the name is reserved by a repository in the trash until it is purged or restored (error codes conflict, name_reserved)

post.description: Upload a package into a hosted rpm repository (multipart/form-data). Requires write access.

get.description: Build an OpenVEX 0.2.0 (default) or CycloneDX VEX document from the latest vulnerability scans and the recorded VEX decisions. With `artifact_id` it covers one artifact, otherwise every scanned artifact of the repository. Status per vulnerability: the recorded decision; else `fixed` when the scan's `fixed_in` is at or below the artifact version; else `affected` when the scan quarantined the artifact; else `under_investigation`. `not_affected` only comes from a recorded decision. Admin only.

parameters.name: spec_version
parameters.description: CycloneDX spec version (1.4, 1.5 or 1.6; default 1.5). CycloneDX only.

parameters.name: artifact_id
parameters.description: Restrict the document to one artifact (`name@version`).

parameters.name: attest
parameters.description: `true` returns the document as a signed in-toto attestation in a DSSE envelope; `bundle` returns a Sigstore bundle, the input of `cosign verify-blob-attestation`. Verify with the key from `/.well-known/openartifact/attestation-key.pem`.

200.description: VEX document, or its attestation with `attest`

get.description: List the VEX decisions recorded for a repository, optionally for one artifact. Admin only.

put.description: Record (or replace) the decision for one vulnerability of one artifact. `not_affected` requires a `justification`; other statuses must not carry one. Admin only.

delete.description: Delete a recorded VEX decision; the vulnerability falls back to its derived status. Admin only.

post.description: Detect the licenses of an artifact from its stored package file (the wheel METADATA, package.json, Cargo.toml, .nuspec, pom or gemspec it declares) and from its license properties, evaluate the license policies and record the result. A violated policy with action `block` quarantines the artifact: downloads answer 403 `ARTIFACT_QUARANTINED` until an admin approves it.

200.description: License scan result with the policy violations

422.description: The artifact's metadata is too large or ambiguous to be read safely (`unsafe_artifact`), or its license cannot be read from its file while a blocking license policy applies (`unreadable_artifact`)

post.description: Copies every item of a sealed bundle into target_repo and moves the bundle to to_stage (admin only). Items are copied as metadata that references the same stored blobs (no bytes are duplicated), in one transaction: either every item lands and the promotion is recorded, or nothing changes. The target's storage quota is charged, its license policies and immutable_releases setting are enforced, and quarantined source artifacts are refused. An artifact already present in the target with the same content counts as existing (so a retry is idempotent); different content at the same coordinates is a 409. Emits the bundle.promoted webhook event.

post.description: Hosted raw repositories on any storage backend with a staging area: S3-compatible and GCS (presigned URLs), Azure (SAS URLs), and the filesystem and OCI registry backends (short-lived HMAC-signed URLs served by this server, which need `baseUrl` to be set). Returns a short-lived presigned PUT URL to a staging object; upload the bytes directly to it, then call the complete endpoint. Files above 5 GiB (up to 5 TiB) must set `multipart`: the response then carries the part plan instead of a URL, and each part URL comes from the parts endpoint. Requires write permission on the repository and on the path. The response carries a bearer credential and is sent with Cache-Control: no-store. A user may have at most storage.presignMaxPendingUploads uploads outstanding (not completed, not expired).

400.description: Invalid path, size, part size or sha256 (code invalid_size also when a size above 5 GiB lacks `multipart`, or is too large for a single upload on Azure), or the repository is not a hosted raw repository

429.description: Too many outstanding uploads for this user (retry after the Retry-After header)

501.description: The storage backend does not support presigned uploads

post.description: Verifies that the staged object has the declared size and sha256, moves it to its content-addressed key, records the artifact (overwriting an existing path, like a raw PUT) and deletes the staging object. Only the creator of the upload or an administrator may complete it. The server reads the object back (up to 5 TiB) in a detached job (30 minutes plus about one second per 20 MiB, at most 6 hours) that survives a client disconnect; the read and the move are conditional on the object version seen at verification, so an object re-uploaded in between is refused. The call is idempotent: the first success returns 201, a retry returns 200 with the same body, and a retry while a verification is running returns 409 upload_in_progress. On a size or sha256 mismatch, or when the object changed during verification, the staging object and the upload are discarded and nothing is recorded. The repository's storage quota is enforced (507 quota_exceeded: the upload stays pending, nothing is recorded, and completing again after freeing space works); license and secret scanning are not applied, as for a raw PUT.

Code upload_incomplete: a part of a multipart upload is missing or has the wrong size (the message names the part numbers; upload them and call complete again). Code upload_changed: the staged object was overwritten during verification; the upload was discarded. Code immutable_release: the path already exists in a repository with `immutable_releases`; nothing was recorded and the upload stays pending (retry with `force=true` as an administrator)

post.description: Returns presigned PUT URLs for up to 100 parts of a multipart upload, each for exactly the returned size. Call it as often as needed (URLs live as long as the single-upload URL, and every call extends the upload's deadline), PUT the parts in any order and in parallel, then call complete. A part may be re-uploaded. The response carries bearer credentials and is sent with Cache-Control: no-store. Only the creator of the upload or an administrator may call it.
